content: It's a good app for transportation but it should be better if there is an option for a chat or call driver for the same. As sometimes due to network issues we are not able to receive the calls from the driver so in that case that would be useful if we have an option for chatting with the driver or else we can call them once we are in the network zone.

The worst app I have ever seen. The app crashes frequently in first place. When try to make booking or update details it stops working and get closed by itself. After many attempts of reinstallation, still issue continues. When checking the vehicle location, it is not showing the correct location. In short, data, energy and time waste. Please fix. Being in market for long years is not so important, providing user friendly digital service and making the travel experience peaceful is much needed

App is poorly developed. There are lot of technical issues. Textboxes do not support autocorrect and autocomplete so you have to type every letter and auto correct word gets erased. Even if you provide feedback through received notification app does not understand it and ask me to again provide feedback upon opening & blocks me. Hi, sorry for the inconvenience. We are working on implementing this!
It shall be available in the form of a future update, do keep an eye out!

content: The app frequently crashes or hangs while booking cabs, which makes it really frustrating, especially when I’m in a hurry. The GPS tracking is unreliable—it often shows the driver in the wrong location, causing unnecessary delays. Notifications are delayed or sometimes don’t come at all, so I end up missing important updates about my ride.

Very bad experience using this app. Most of the time doesn't work and gives error. Somehow if I was able to book the seat also, at the time of boarding the bus mostly doesn't open and I end up losing my booked seat. Was hardly able to track the bus using this app. Issue reported to my company transport department many times but they also couldn't resolve my issue. If you can't provide equal treatment to all the users and can't resolve the issues faced by the users, better to not deploy such apps
replyContent: We apologize for the inconvenience. We request that you share your booking details at app@moveinsync.com and we will definitely look into it.

content: PLEASE add a soft denial option or confirmation prompt 45–60 mins before pickup. Many don’t confirm and only cancel when the cab arrives, wasting time, fuel, and effort. Drivers navigate traffic just to reach a no-show, affecting the schedule for everyone. A timely confirmation or denial would avoid unnecessary delays and help improve overall efficiency of the cab service.

I had a very disappointing experience with Move In Sync. The cab was shown at a different location due to a glitch in the app, but the driver reached the correct location and left without picking me up. When I contacted the helpdesk for assistance, their response was unhelpful, and they did not communicate with me politely. The lack of cooperation and poor customer service was very frustrating.

One thing I hate about the app is that the map keeps zooming out after 2-3 seconds whenever I zoom in to see my driver's exact location. It's an inconvenience during both pickup and drop. Please disable the option or place a button to enable/disable the function. I do not like zooming in again and again. Imagine Google Maps doing the same, it would be very annoying
replyContent: We understand this can be frustrating. We are working towards making this better. We would appreciate it if you could send us the details at app@moveinsync.com.
